assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game town-screen BACKGROUND PLATE for a Three Kingdoms strategy game. Create one extraordinarily detailed hand-painted / late-1990s prerendered strategy-game town panorama, with the richness, tactile material detail, theatrical lighting and picturesque composition of a Heroes of Might and Magic III town screen, reimagined as an ORIGINAL ancient Chinese Han dynasty settlement, no European architecture. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2, high resolution. Elevated oblique viewpoint looking over a terraced riverside Chinese town toward misty mountains, distant forests and a golden clouded sky. Warm amber sunlight from upper left, blue-green atmospheric distance, mossy grey masonry, aged timber, terracotta paths, jade glazed roofs, delicate foliage, believable environmental storytelling. Permanent governor's residence small in distant upper center, distant ordinary residential houses and enclosing outer rampart as scenery. Main foreground and middle ground must contain EMPTY open grass and gravel terraces / courtyards linked by winding cobblestone paths: these are spaces for separate gameplay building sprites. Leave nine generous empty insertion areas spread across the foreground and midground, do not paint market, farms, granary, military barracks, workshop, clinic, training grounds, recruiting hall or monumental front gate into those spaces. Do not put any large foreground subject in these nine spaces. Scenic river on far left and lower left edge, weathered small bridge, willow trees, rocks, little shrines only on edges; a few tiny distant townspeople. This is an immersive painterly environment, NOT a technical map or flat isometric diamond board. Depict authentic intricate Han wooden beams, worn steps, mountain depth and rich vegetation around the edges. Lower 70 percent holds the usable ground with clear empty sites. No text, UI, labels, watermarks, grid, borders, logos or European fantasy castles. No cartoon, no flat SVG / vector aesthetic, no low-poly, no plain slabs.

Create one high-quality square game ART ATLAS with an exact 3 by 3 layout of nine equally sized Han Chinese architectural vignettes. Rich detailed prerendered painterly architecture inspired by Heroes of Might and Magic III town screens. Not a diagram, not vector, not low poly. Golden sunlight from upper left, same elevated oblique 3/4 camera in all cells, intricate jade and terracotta roofs, weathered timber beams, stone steps, moss, foliage and many small believable props. Each of the nine scenes is a standalone facility with a small patch of muted earthy olive grass and sandy soil; the same flat muted sage beige color around each vignette so scene edges can softly fade into a larger town panorama. No sky, no far background, no text, no labels, no visible cell borders, no watermark. Every facility entirely contained inside its square cell with a wide clear margin, ground baseline near 80 percent cell height, its building about 70 percent of cell width. Ordered left to right, top to bottom: first row: a MARKET compound with red ochre fabric awnings and shop carts, a golden WHEAT FARM with field rows farmhouse and hay, a large timber GRANARY with raised warehouses grain sacks cart. Second row: a WORKSHOP forge with tiled sheds glowing kiln chimney tools, a BARRACKS compound with fortified entrance tiled halls crimson banners courtyard, a CLINIC with jade roof medicinal herbs paper windows drying racks. Third row: an open TRAINING GROUND with targets weapon racks flags pavilion, a grey stone CITY GATE with two roofed watchtowers and crenellated walls, an elegant RECRUITING HALL with double jade roof red pillars stairs ornamental trees. Nine beautiful picturesque original Chinese facilities in one 3x3 asset atlas. Extremely detailed and game-ready.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated game sprite of an authentic ancient Chinese Han dynasty building construction site, on genuine transparent background, square image. Rich hand-painted / prerendered late-1990s strategy game town-screen art, intricate realistic material detail like Heroes of Might and Magic III buildings reimagined for historical China. Elevated 3/4 camera, front faces lower left, golden sunlight upper left. A partially built Chinese timber hall with elaborate bamboo and wood scaffolding, incomplete jade roof, wooden gantry, grey stone foundation, clay roof tiles in piles, wheelbarrow, timber stacks, rope pulleys, baskets, a few tiny ancient workmen. Warm brown timber, mossy grey stone, small foliage, deeply textured architectural shading. Entire object fully inside frame with 10 percent transparent margin; horizontal center, ground baseline about 83 percent of the image height. Include only small natural footprint soil and cast shadow; no big flat diamond platform or scenery. NO text, labels, border, UI, watermark, painted checkerboard, European architecture, vector, cartoon or low-poly. True alpha transparency around object.

Edit this existing 3 by 3 game building atlas. Preserve every building, prop, tree, wheat field, architectural detail, perspective, color, lighting, position and exact 3 by 3 cell layout without redesigning or moving anything. Remove ONLY the flat sage-beige background surrounding the nine facility vignettes and make it genuine alpha transparency. Keep the small natural ground footprints and shadows directly underneath each building, with softly feathered edges. Each building must remain exactly within its existing one-third by one-third cell so the atlas crop coordinates remain valid. No text, no new objects, no redesign. Output the same square 3 by 3 atlas on a true transparent background.
